deadline.value: Priority deadline for Fall is December 15; applications are accepted until positions are filled.

also.quote: However, applications will be accepted until all positions are filled.

gre_general.value: The general GRE is encouraged but not required. The requirements page also says it is required, which is not resolved.
gre_general.quote: It is recommended (not required) that all applicants have the results of the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) sent directly to the University

also.quote: We encourage applicants to submit the general GRE; however, it is not required.

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry subject GRE is not required, but applicants are encouraged to send one.
gre_subject.quote: Although the subject GRE is not required, candidates are encouraged to provide a subject GRE score to strengthen their file

fee_waiver.value: The department says neither it nor the university can waive the application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: Neither the Department nor the University is able to waive the application fee

supervisor.value: No advisor needs to be chosen before applying; admission is decided by the graduate committee.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to contact and choose an advisor prior to applying to the graduate program? | No.

also.quote: Admissions decisions are based on a holistic review of the applicant's file by our graduate committee

funding.value: Most doctoral applicants are considered for a teaching assistantship with tuition paid; the department says it does not usually admit PhD students without funding.
funding.quote: It is not our standard practice to admit doctoral students without financial support

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's degree or higher can apply; the page also gives a separate credit path for master's holders.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited college or university | Minimum Total Credit Hours for Post-Master's Students

notes: Department pages disagree on the GRE: the requirements page says 'The general GRE exam is required' in one sentence and 'recommended (not required)' in another; the FAQ says not required. Saved as Recommended. Teaching assistantship stipend is listed on the requirements page.
